aries.regular: makes the difference between being considerate and consistently putting ourselves last easier to notice
aries.fullMoon: illuminates the Aries-Libra axis between honoring our individual needs and nurturing our relationships
aries.solarEclipse: pulls our cravings, passions, and instincts into sharp focus; Aries doesn’t wait for permission

taurus.regular: encourages us to stay grounded, breathe deeper, and listen to our bodies
taurus.newMoon: invites us to reconnect with what sustains us: our bodies, the earth, and the simple pleasures that ground us in the here and now
taurus.fullMoon: illuminates the tension between what we hold and what we must release

gemini.regular: invites a shift toward movement, conversation, learning, and conscious curiosity
gemini.newMoon: awakens our curiosity and sparks our intellect
gemini.fullMoon: calls us to bridge the gap between the information we gather and the wisdom we share

cancer.regular: pulls us home to the places, people, and memories that nurture us
cancer.newMoon: calls us home, not just to the place where we live, but to the emotional center that grounds and nourishes us
cancer.fullMoon: can bring a heightened focus on domestic issues such as housing, food security, childcare, or healthcare

leo.regular: helps us access that inner fire more easily
leo.newMoon: marks a powerful moment of self-renewal, a return to who we are beneath the roles, the expectations, and the noise
leo.fullMoon: brings what has been hidden into view; the cycle peaks, and this is the moment of truth

virgo.newMoon: calls us to clear the clutter, refine our routines, and prioritize the details that nourish our well-being
virgo.solarEclipse: reminds us that striving for perfection can hinder growth
virgo.lunarEclipse: separates signal from noise, illuminating the cracks in our systems

libra.regular: brings our attention to relationships and how we show up in them
libra.newMoon: offers a doorway to begin again
libra.fullMoon: reflects back the dynamics that shape our connections

scorpio.newMoon: pulls us into the depths of our inner world, inviting us to confront, transform, and release what no longer serves our growth
scorpio.fullMoon: pulls focus to what nourishes us and what consumes us, what we own and what we owe

sagittarius.regular: favors honesty, though it can get lost in the big picture
sagittarius.fullMoon: illuminates the tension between what we know and what we seek to understand

capricorn.regular: brings emotional fatigue as the pressure to keep it all together catches up
capricorn.fullMoon: shines a spotlight on the delicate balance between our private lives and public ambitions

aquarius.regular: reminds us that truth is not always comfortable, but it is necessary
aquarius.newMoon: invites us to envision the world we want to live in and take bold steps toward it, both as individuals and as part of something larger
aquarius.fullMoon: highlights the tension between the person we’ve learned to perform and the person we actually are

pisces.regular: pulls us toward the unseen and the space between endings and beginnings
pisces.newMoon: pulls us into the unseen and the space between endings and beginnings
pisces.lunarEclipse: brings release and revelation, revealing truths we’ve long avoided
